```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse,posterior,bayesplot,cmdstanr,patchwork,ordbetareg,shiny)


simulate_data = function(n = 1000){
  # -----------------------------
  # Set parameters
  # -----------------------------
  n_trials <- n        # number of trials
  sigma_e <- abs(rnorm(1,1,5))           # noise on evidence (needs to be fixed for now)
  
  sigma_m = abs(rnorm(1,1,5))
  conf_prec = abs(rnorm(1,100,50))
  c0 = -abs(rnorm(1,5,1))
  c1 = abs(rnorm(1,5,1))
  
  mu_k <- 0                  # criterion mean on the evidence scale (gaussian distribution)
  sigma_k <- abs(rnorm(1,1,5))                 # criterion sd on the evidence scale (gaussian distribution)
  
  
  # Coherence level (stimulus intensity)
  X <- abs(rnorm(n_trials,0,1))
  
  # stimuli (left or right)
  D <- sample(c(-1, 1), n_trials, replace = TRUE)  # true stimulus
  
  # Simulate evidence
  e <- rnorm(n_trials, mean = D * X, sd = sigma_e)
  
  # Compute posterior P(D=1|e)
  
  ehat = rnorm(n_trials,e,sigma_m)
  
  # Evidence-based stochastic policy (guassian distribution for citera)
  k_gauss <- rnorm(n_trials, mu_k, sigma_k)          # citerion on trial t
  p_gauss = pnorm((e-mu_k)/sigma_k)                  #  probability of response on trial t given the citerion
  a_gauss = rbinom(n_trials,1,p_gauss)               # binary response
  
  c_mu = ifelse(a_gauss == 1, brms::inv_logit_scaled(2*ehat*X / (sigma_e^2 + sigma_m^2)),
                1-brms::inv_logit_scaled(2*ehat*X / (sigma_e^2 + sigma_m^2)))
  
  
  
  C = ordbetareg::rordbeta(n_trials,c_mu,conf_prec,c(c0,c1))
  
  # Dataframe
  df = data.frame(
    c0 = c0,
    c1 = c1,
    sigma_k = sigma_k,
    sigma_e = sigma_e,
    conf_prec = conf_prec,
    sigma_m = sigma_m,
    e = e,
    ehat = ehat,
    D = D,
    X =X,
    ACC = ifelse(a_gauss == 0 & D == -1, 1, ifelse(a_gauss == 1 & D == 1, 1,0)),
    c_mu = c_mu,
    C = C,
    a_gauss = a_gauss
  )
}  

```


```{r, fig.height=12,fig.width=8}
df = simulate_data()
df %>% ggplot(aes(x = X*D, y = a_gauss))+geom_point()
df %>% ggplot(aes(x = X*D, y = C, col = as.factor(ACC)))+geom_point()+geom_smooth()



fit = function(){
  
  df = simulate_data()

  mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Derivations","heurestic.stan"))
  
  datastan = list(a = df$a_gauss,
                  ACC = df$ACC,
                  C = df$C,
                  N = nrow(df),
                  X = df$X * df$D)
  
  
  fit = mod$sample(data = datastan,
                   iter_warmup = 500,
                   refresh = 100,
                   iter_sampling = 500,
             parallel_chains = 4)
  
  estimated = fit$summary("gm") %>% mutate(variable = c("beta",
                                            "conf_prec",
                                            "meta_un_cor",
                                            "meta_un_inc",
                                            "meta_bias_cor",
                                            "meta_bias_inc"))
  
  estimated2 = fit$summary(c("beta",
                                            "conf_prec",
                                            "meta_un_cor",
                                            "meta_un_inc",
                                            "meta_bias_cor",
                                            "meta_bias_inc"))
  
  
  simulated = data.frame(c0 = unique(df$c0),
                         c1 = unique(df$c1),
                         sigma_k = unique(df$sigma_k),
                         sigma_e =unique(df$sigma_e),
                         sigma_m =unique(df$sigma_m),
                         conf_prec =unique(df$conf_prec))
  
  result = list(simulated, estimated,estimated2,df, div = data.frame(fit$diagnostic_summary()))
  
  return(result)
}

qq = fit()

```
